source.method: Public client-bundle formula and serialized Next.js RSC inputs

algorithm.perSkill: Use the factor page's courseEffectSet row. Score the base-family course effect; halve it when the selected main deck already provides the skill/family; multiply upgraded/base-linked skills by 1.4999999999999998; round to 2 decimals.
algorithm.hintTable: Score each literal hintSkillId as 1000*skillScore/point. Pad tables shorter than 7 with -2 entries, average across the padded table, multiply by 7 (or 8.4 at Hint Lv Up 4) and the reciprocal hint-Pt discount, then round to 2 decimals.
algorithm.eventChoice: For each event choice, average hint level for each skill across its result outcomes and use occurrence frequency as drop rate. Sum skillScore*dropRate*hintMultiplier*eventTypeRate*750/point. Use the highest scoring choice per event.
algorithm.events: Random event rate is 0.5; sequence/continuous event rate is 0.9. Round each event-group total to 2 decimals.
algorithm.total: round2(10 + hint + random + sequence). Exclude selected main-deck cards, sort descending by total, and display the first 48.

courseEffectSet.note: The exact factor scorer consumes U-tools' factor-page courseEffectSet. This is not interchangeable with the normal prerequisite-free course expected-effect dataset.
courseEffectSet.exactWhen: A matching U-tools factor page has been imported for the selected event/course/style.
courseEffectSet.fallback: For courses without an imported U-tools factor courseEffectSet, the Training Lab must label any derived score as an approximation rather than U-tools-exact.
